observations: Two large rectangular forms fill the upper half, each containing concentric amber and yellow loops; a bright white bloom sits near the center of the left form.
Diagonal pale beams cross from upper-left toward lower-right, meeting a dark horizontal band edged with a zigzag border in brown and black.
Short lines in teal, red, pink, and yellow are scattered across an olive-brown background that carries looping grey marks near the edges.
reading: Two glowing rectangular masses sit side by side, their amber cores ringed by tight loops that pull the eye inward. Pale beams slice across the lower field and land on a zigzag band that anchors the composition at mid-height. The teal and red marks scattered across the surface read as restless against the warm stillness of those central blooms — pressure and calm sharing the same space.
